title: Rosemary Beach: Rosemary's Pineapple Carriage House in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Rosemary's Pineapple Carriage House in Rosemary Beach. Nestled within a serene courtyard, discover the enchanting Rosemary's Pineapple Carriage House, an exquisite hideaway exuding coastal charm and tranquility.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Nestled within a serene courtyard, discover the enchanting Rosemary's Pineapple Carriage House, an exquisite hideaway exuding coastal charm and tranquility. This retreat boasts hardwood floors, custom woodwork ceilings, and an abundance of windows flooding the space with natural light, creating an inviting ambiance that instantly puts you at ease.

Step inside the main floor of the carriage house, where you'll find a full kitchen, living area, dining space, cozy bunk room, and a full bathroom, providing ample space to accommodate extra guests or children. Ascend the spiral wood stairs to the upper level and unveil the main bedroom loft, where comfort and relaxation await amidst tasteful decor and luxurious furnishings.

Outside the main floor, a private balcony beckons, offering the perfect spot to savor your morning coffee or unwind with a glass of wine as you soak in the tranquil surroundings. Whether you're lounging on the balcony, gathering with loved ones in the spacious living areas, or exploring the vibrant streets of Rosemary Beach, Rosemary's Pineapple Carriage House provides the perfect backdrop for your coastal escape.

Immerse yourself in the laid-back atmosphere of this charming coastal community, where pristine beaches, boutique shops, and delectable dining options await just moments away. Whether you're seeking outdoor adventures or leisurely strolls along the shore, Rosemary Beach offers something for everyone.
